Item.Name: S_EQUIPMENT_TYPE
Item.Hint: Scan equipment bar code, or enter 'M' for manual entry.

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_start_code varchar2(3) := '+';
 temp_end_code varchar2(3) := '+';
 temp_len number;
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 temp_len := length(temp_start_code);
 if :s_equipment_type = 'M' then
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 NEXT_ITEM;
 else
 if length(:s_equipment_type) != 6 + length(temp_start_code) + length(temp_end_code) then
 :s_equipment_type := null;
 show_error ('1210'); --invalid scan length
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if nvl(substr(:s_equipment_type, 1, temp_len),'nullx') != nvl(temp_start_code,'nullx') or
 nvl(substr(:s_equipment_type, 7 + temp_len, length(temp_start_code)),'nullx') !=
 nvl(temp_end_code,'nullx') then
 :s_equipment_type := null;
 show_error ('6076'); --invalid start/end code
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
-- check and see if a valid equipment reference number
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x from equipment e
 where e.equip_reference = 'EQ-'||substr(:s_equipment_type, temp_len + 1, 6);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error ('1336');
 check_package_failure;
 end;

-- check and see if authorized to make edits for equipment of this type

 begin
 select 'X' into :global.x
 from fcn_grp_priv f, equip_access_privs ea, equipment e
 where f.appl_id = 'DON'
 and f.user_id = upper(:banner.user_id)
 and ea.fcn_grp = f.grp_id
 and ea.equip_type = e.equip_type
 and e.equip_reference= 'EQ-'||substr(:s_equipment_type, temp_len + 1, 6)
 and sysdate between ea.eff_date and nvl(ea.term_date, sysdate+1);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error ('1302');
 check_package_failure;
 end;

-- set all ctrl blk and equipment block values, then populate all equipment details

 begin
 select e.equip_type, substr(m.code_desc,1,13), e.equip_id, e.equip_reference
 into :CTRL_BLK_1.equipment_type, :CTRL_BLK_1.s_equip_desc, :CTRL_BLK_1.equipment_id,
 :CTRL_BLK_1.equipment_reference
 from equipment e, equip_master_codes m
 where e.equip_reference = 'EQ-'||substr(:s_equipment_type, temp_len + 1, 6)
 and m.code = e.equip_type
 and m.code_type = 'EQUIP';
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 GO_ITEM ('EQUIPMENT_REFERENCE');
 execute_trigger ('KEY-NEXT-ITEM');
 end if;
end;

Item.Name: DOWNTIME_START
Item.Hint: Enter start date and time for downtime event, (MM-DD-YY HH:MI, 24 hr format)

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
--
-- Invalid date is trapped by on_error. On_error routine will Popup an error screen, if you try
-- to display another error using show_error. On_error is invoked the first time that the contents 
-- of the date field is referenced, so this section of code just checks for date format errors using the
-- on_error checks.
--
 begin
 :GLOBAL.date := to_char(:equip_event.downtime_start, 'MM-DD-YY');
 exception
 when others then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;
--
 if ((:EQUIP_EVENT.downtime_start is null) and (:equip_event.downtime_code is not null)) then 
 show_error ('0080');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if (:EQUIP_EVENT.downtime_start > 
 nvl(:EQUIP_EVENT.downtime_end, :EQUIP_EVENT.downtime_start)) then
 show_error ('1347');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
--
 if (:equip_event.downtime_start > nvl(:equip_event.service_start, :equip_event.downtime_start)) then
 show_error ('1366');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
--
 if ((:equip_event.downtime_start> sysdate) and (:equip_event.downtime_flag = 'N')) then
 show_error ('1360');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_local_time date;
 v_gmt_time date;
 v_gmt_time_end date;
begin
 execute_trigger ('validate_event');
 check_package_failure; 
 
 if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 if ((v_local_time>= nvl(:equip_event.downtime_start, v_local_time+1)) and
 (v_local_time <= nvl(:equip_event.downtime_end, v_local_time+1))) then
 begin
 update equipment e
 set e.status = 'DOWN'
 where e.equip_reference = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_reference;
 end;
 end if;
 LOCK TABLE equipment_event in exclusive mode;
 select 'DT-'||substr(to_char(to_number(nvl(max(substr(event_reference, 4)),0))+1,'099999'),2,6)
 into :EQUIP_EVENT.event_reference
 from equipment_event;
 :equip_event.insert_user := :banner.user_id;
 :equip_event.insert_date := sysdate;
 else -- timezone
 if ((sysdate>= nvl(:equip_event.downtime_start, sysdate+1)) and
 (sysdate <= nvl(:equip_event.downtime_end, sysdate+1))) then
 begin
 update equipment e
 set e.status = 'DOWN'
 where e.equip_reference = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_reference;
 end;
 end if;
--
 LOCK TABLE equipment_event in exclusive mode;
--
 select 'DT-'||substr(to_char(to_number(nvl(max(substr(event_reference, 4)),0))+1,'099999'),2,6)
 into :EQUIP_EVENT.event_reference
 from equipment_event;
 :equip_event.insert_user := :banner.user_id;
 :equip_event.insert_date := sysdate;
 
 end if; --timezone
--
if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id,:equip_event.downtime_start,v_gmt_time);
 :equip_event.downtime_start :=v_gmt_time;
 else
 :equip_event.downtime_start := :equip_event.downtime_start;
 end if;
 
 if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id,:equip_event.downtime_end,v_gmt_time_end);
 :equip_event.downtime_end := v_gmt_time_end; 
 else
 :equip_event.downtime_end := :equip_event.downtime_end;
 end if;
 
 if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id,:equip_event.SERVICE_START,v_gmt_time);
 :equip_event.SERVICE_START :=v_gmt_time;
 else
 :equip_event.SERVICE_START := :equip_event.SERVICE_START;
 end if; 
 
 if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id,:equip_event.SERVICE_END,v_gmt_time_end);
 :equip_event.SERVICE_END := v_gmt_time_end; 
 else
 :equip_event.SERVICE_END := :equip_event.SERVICE_END;
 end if; 
 
 :SYSTEM.message_level := 10;
 commit;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_EVENT
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 execute_trigger ('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
--
-- must be either a downtime or service event scheduled
--
 if (:service_code is null and :downtime_code is null) then
 GO_ITEM ('downtime_code');
 show_error ('1358');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
--
-- validate downtime record
--
 if ((:equip_event.downtime_code is not null) or (:equip_event.downtime_start is not null)) then
 if (:equip_event.downtime_code is null) then
 go_item ('downtime_code');
 show_error ('0010');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if (:equip_event.downtime_start is null) then
 go_item ('downtime_start');
 show_error ('0010');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if ((:equip_event.downtime_flag = 'Y') and (:equip_event.downtime_end is null)) then
 go_item ('downtime_end');
 show_error ('0010');
 check_package_failure; 
 end if;
 end if;
--
-- validate service record
--
 if ((:equip_event.service_code is not null) or (:equip_event.service_start is not null) or
 (:equip_event.service_person is not null) or (:equip_event.service_company is not null)) then
 if (:equip_event.service_code is null) then
 go_item ('service_code');
 show_error ('0010');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if (:equip_event.service_start is null) then
 go_item ('service_start');
 show_error ('0010');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 if ((:equip_event.downtime_flag = 'Y') and (:equip_event.service_end is null)) then
 go_item ('downtime_end');
 show_error ('0010');
 check_package_failure; 
 end if;
 if ((:equip_event.service_person is null) and (:equip_event.service_company is null)) then
 go_item ('service_person');
 show_error ('1361');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
end;
